definitions.gloss: traversing lengthwise; crossing from end to end
definitions.explanation: Traveling or extending through something from one end to the other, typically in a north-south direction or along the longer axis.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}{列島|れっとう}を{縦断|じゅうだん}する。
examples.english: To traverse the Japanese archipelago from end to end.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}が{本州|ほんしゅう}を{縦断|じゅうだん}した。
examples.english: The typhoon crossed through Honshu from end to end.

examples.japanese: アメリカ{縦断|じゅうだん}の{旅|たび}に{出|で}た。
examples.english: I set off on a trip traversing America from north to south.

notes:
{縦断|じゅうだん} refers to crossing lengthwise.

DIRECTION:
- {縦断|じゅうだん}: north-south or lengthwise traversal
- {横断|おうだん}: east-west or crosswise traversal

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縦断|じゅうだん}する: to traverse lengthwise
- {縦断|じゅうだん}{道路|どうろ}: north-south highway
- {縦断|じゅうだん}{旅行|りょこう}: lengthwise journey
- ～を{縦断|じゅうだん}: to cross through ～ lengthwise

USAGE:
The direction depends on the orientation of the area. For Japan (oriented north-south), {縦断|じゅうだん} means north-south travel.
